---
title: "Lock and Synchronize R Packages"
subtitle: "Keep project packages separate from the immutable runtime"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

`uvr.toml` declares direct R requirements and `uvr.lock` records their resolved
versions. The SIF supplies the stable R ABI and the `uvr` executable. At
runtime, `uvr` owns its project library, cache, R-version resolution, and
activation files; the container and runner do not override them.

Only packages required by the scaffold are declared now. Add readers,
transformers, validators, and release tooling only after the corresponding
Manual decisions and code exist.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Direct Dependencies"}

Review the dependency list below. A dependency belongs here only when Manual or
pipeline code imports it.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-config-toml file="{{ emit.project_root }}/uvr.toml" title="Emit The R Package Declaration"}

```toml
[project]
name = "prospectorMDGHealthshedClinicData"
r_version = "4.5.1"

[dependencies]
parsermd = "*"
skimr = "*"
duckdb = "*"
duckplyr = "*"
here = "*"
targets = "*"
tarchetypes = "*"
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Resolve And Synchronize In The Container"}

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr lock
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr sync
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr sync --frozen
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr activate --write-shim
```

Commit `uvr.lock` only after successful resolution through the built runtime.
Use `uvr r pin` only when an additional exact `.r-version` pin is intentional;
do not generate that optional file outside `uvr`.

Run scripts through `uvr run`. For an interactive session, enter the container
shell and source `.uvr/activate`; that shim asks `uvr` to resolve the current
project environment instead of storing hard-coded paths.

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The R Environment Contract"}

```sh
test -f uvr.toml
rg -n '^r_version = "4.5.1"|^targets =|^tarchetypes =' uvr.toml
test -f uvr.lock
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr sync --frozen
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript -e 'library(targets)'
```

:::
